primary_antecedent.scope: Ordinary fixed-endpoint iterated tests on an arbitrary closed conic submanifold; every wavefront point is a coisotropic point, with minimum dimension and Lagrangian equality cases.
primary_antecedent.qualification: No involutivity assertion is made away from allowed wavefront points unless every point is to be permitted. No converse phase theorem is inferred from coisotropy alone.

source_correspondence: The hypothesis is every finite ordinary proper word at one fixed Besov endpoint on an arbitrary closed conic submanifold; no Lagrangian property is assumed.
Proper positive-order elliptic tests outside the closed set, their actual powers and full microlocal parametrices give every Sobolev gain and wavefront containment.
Scalar-principal commutator cancellation gives exact order one and the 1/i Poisson sign. Its powers are expanded as ordered words; the commutator itself is not assumed admissible.

Every conormal first jet is explicitly realized by a homogeneous degree-one vanishing function. Radial tangency, transverse slice, submanifold coordinates, compact conic cutoff and low-frequency/proper quantization margins are retained.

The conormal/Hamilton correspondence and exact symplectic double orthogonal prove pointwise coisotropy, the minimum dimension and Lagrangian equality. The all-point involutivity conclusion has its necessary quantifier.

The noninvolutive two-dimensional example has an elliptic commutator and exact proper multiplier version. The conormal example has its exact phase/order and a direct nonzero wavefront proof. The ordered expansion example distinguishes word length 2N from elliptic order N and retains the strict Sobolev endpoint.
The exact current ordinary composition, principal bracket, proper inverse, all-real endpoint/Sobolev, conic slice and symplectic geometry providers were checked.
Thirty-two finite checks verify ordered powers through N=5, Poisson signs, tangent planes, dimensions and normalization. All analytic and geometric arguments are written in the lesson.
All 175 formulas and twenty displays parse.
The exact source remark at IV5 was read. No source previews, backups, workers or messages were created. No additional owned disposable file was confirmed.
